title: naive.config.json
description: A venture's overrides to Naive's defaults, at the venture root (P-2, like next.config.js): the gate (fail-closed routes, rules over the router's path patterns, which package rules it imports), function owners, check settings (P-7, like eslint.config.mjs), thresholds, which System 1 questions run, pinned package versions (U-4) and how strictly the acting role is checked (M-18). Every field is optional; a missing one keeps the default in packages/naive/src/engine/naive-config.ts. node packages/naive/src/checks/check-config.ts <venture dir> checks it.

loops.description: How far the loop goes on its own when a function workflow is due (EE-183, packages/naive/src/engine/loop.ts, naive loop): manual, the default, starts nothing; ask files a decision per due occurrence and starts on the answer start; auto starts the workflow as its function agent. The most specific mode wins: workflow, then function, then mode. No mode goes past the gate. packages/naive/src/checks/check-config.ts holds each name to the venture's functions and workflows.

mode.description: The mode for every workflow that has none of its own

functions.description: Per function id in venture.json departments

workflows.description: Per workflow, named <function>/<workflow>. A mode here also lets the loop act on a workflow the venture's phase does not list as active.

set_by.description: The person who last set a mode, and when. A mode of ask or auto counts only with it.

visibility.description: The venture's own lines for the visibility rubric (EE-222, packages/naive/src/functions/it/visibility-rubric.json, naive tools recommend). A criterion left out keeps the rubric's default weight, which is an unvalidated prior. packages/naive/src/checks/check-config.ts holds each criterion id to the rubric.

weights.description: Per criterion id: the weight for this venture in place of the rubric's default. A weight of 0 leaves the criterion out of the score, and never out of the blind spot.

must.description: Per criterion id: the lowest score a candidate needs. A candidate below it is ruled out whatever the rest.

specialists.description: The venture's own lines for the temporary specialists a function agent spawns (EE-213, packages/naive/src/engine/agents/specialist.ts, naive agent spawn). Naive's defaults are unvalidated priors in packages/naive/src/engine/specialists.json.

default_ttl.description: How long a specialist's reach lasts when the spawn names no ttl, as a number and a unit such as "2 hours". A spawn's own --ttl still wins

activity_proposals.description: The venture's own lines for the activity catalog's proposal rules (EE-170, packages/naive/src/engine/activity-proposals.ts, naive activities). A rule left out keeps the catalog's lines. packages/naive/src/checks/check-config.ts holds each rule id to the catalog and each line to its scale's range.

rules.description: Per rule id in packages/naive/src/functions/activities.json proposal_rules: off, so the rule proposes nothing in this venture, or the venture's lines

when.description: The venture's lines for the rule, in place of all of the catalog's. An activity with no score on a named scale does not match.

at_least.description: The score is this or higher.

at_most.description: The score is this or lower.

probe_rate.description: The share of noise receptions surfaced anyway and marked as probes, so a recipe can be scored on signals the current one never surfaced (packages/naive/src/engine/recipes/probes.ts). 0 by default, because probes cost attention. Marking probes in reception files is build plan item 9 (not built).

durable.description: Durable work (EE-161, Effect runtime plan phase 11). engine memory (the default) keeps no state across processes; sqlite runs each handoff as an Effect workflow stored in .naive/durable.sqlite, so a run that dies resumes without rerunning a finished done-criterion; postgres runs the same engine on the client the host's sql hook provides, and is refused without one.

sync.description: Offline sync with a business store (EE-178, docs/design/OFFLINE_SYNC_2026-11-25.md). host is the address naive sync link signs in to when --host is not passed; Naive ships no host of its own, so there is no default. No token lives here: it goes to the operating system's keychain, and the working copy's own sync state to .naive/sync.json.

host.description: The host's base URL, such as https://example.test

traces.description: Traces in the venture's files (EE-121): true writes one span per step of an agent run to traces/<session>.jsonl, hash-chained and linked from provenance. content keeps inputs and outputs too, redacted; off by default because a trace is internal. Off by default.

beta.description: The plugin beta's gate (packages/naive/src/engine/beta-gate.ts): capabilities in beta/capabilities.json unlock in order, each after checkpoint feedback. Off by default.

jev.description: Opt-in for routing feedback through Jev: send lets feedback text leave the machine, and counts only with set_by naming the person who turned it on. A TYPESAFE_API_KEY alone sends nothing.

telemetry.description: Usage telemetry (packages/naive/src/engine/telemetry.ts, packages/naive/src/records/telemetry.schema.json), opt-in: enabled writes events to .naive/telemetry.jsonl; send lets them leave the machine, and counts only with set_by naming the person who turned it on.

gate.description: The venture's one gate (X-5). It runs before every write and never calls a model (X-4).

fail_closed.description: Routes whose agent writes are always drafts; each covers that route and every route under it (X-3)

rules.description: Rules that read the write itself: who writes it, its route, its confidence (X-1, X-2, X-6)

packages.description: Which packages' gate rules the gate imports from their package definitions (X-5): true for all (the default), false for none, or a map of package name to false to leave one out

variants.description: Keep differing agent drafts of one record side by side, with one decision for the founder, on every held route (X-2). A rule can turn this on for its routes alone

owners.description: Function owners: function (department) id to the role that owns it, so a write routed to its owner reaches the right person (X-2)

checks.description: Check settings (P-7): which of a route's checks are off, and which only warn

off.description: Checks that do not run, by path (packages/naive/src/checks/check-telos.ts)

warn.description: Checks that run but do not fail the route's check

investors_lint.description: Investors lint (investors/lint). Each rule is fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed, which makes that rule's findings fail the run.

thresholds.description: Thresholds by name: confidence (the gate's confidence routing), idea-map (when a System 1 answer becomes a tag)

questions.description: Which System 1 questions run, by framework (idea-map): off lists question kinds, the part of a question key before the colon (exists, dept.legal, rec.*)

packages.description: Pinned package versions (U-4): package name to the version the venture uses. A write to a pinned package whose installed version differs is refused until the pin or the install changes. A pin is a version string, or { version, early, channel } as naive upgrade writes it (U-5)

acting.description: How the acting role is checked on every action (M-18)

unknown_roles.description: A role id the team plan does not list: allow (the default, it may reach every route) or refuse

naive.description: The framework version the venture is on, and its channel (EE-076, written by naive upgrade)

kits.description: Mentura kits whose automations this venture turns on

publish_lint.description: The publish lint (packages/naive/src/engine/publish-lint.ts): each rule off, warn or error, the marks to flag, and findings a person waived

marks.description: The names the marks rule flags, each matched case-insensitively on whole words. A string is another company's mark; an object may say private, a name the venture never makes public, which is an error whatever level the marks rule has. The function that writes the words adds its own in marketing/publish-terms.json (EE-214).

publish_build.description: The publish build (packages/naive/src/functions/marketing-and-sales/marketing/publish-build.ts): the venture's channels and the folder they build into. Naive ships no channel; the venture or its app names each one

out.description: The default output folder, relative to the venture folder (default .release/publish-build)

outputs.description: The files the channel writes, relative to the output folder

builders.description: Scripts run in order with node, each relative to the venture folder or absolute

triggers.description: What starts the next step on an event (packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/triggers.ts)

triggers_off.description: Trigger ids switched off: a person answering a failed run with off adds its id here, and the trigger stays off until the id is removed (packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/triggers.ts)

listeners.description: The venture's own signal listeners (signal library design): each joins a signal type to one consumer with that consumer's criterion. A listener here replaces any listener of the same id from a package, a frame or a kit. packages/naive/src/engine/signals.ts merges them and naive signals pull evaluates them

listeners_off.description: Listener ids turned off, from any of the four places listeners come from

product_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the product lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-product.ts, route product/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

diagnose.description: naive diagnose --if-due: a full diagnosis runs only when the founder's transcripts since the cursor reach threshold estimated tokens (characters / 4), or a new session is older than stale_hours

problems.description: The venture's own weights for ranking its customer problems (EE-219), in place of the unvalidated priors in packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/problem-priority.json. A weight left out keeps the prior, and a person sets them (set_by), because what counts as evidence of a problem is a judgment.

set_by.description: The person who set these weights

premise_lint.description: The premise-attack linter (packages/naive/src/checks/premise-lint.ts): each rule, one per aspect, is off, warn (the default) or error

money_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the money lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-money.ts, route money/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

customers_lint.description: Customers lint (customers/lint). Per rule, mode fail-closed makes that rule's findings exit 1. The default is fail-open.

validation_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the validation lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-validation.ts, route validation/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

finance_lint.description: finance/lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-finance.ts). Each rule warns and stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed, which makes its findings exit 1.

legal_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the legal lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-legal.ts, route legal/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

foundation_lint.description: Foundation lint (foundation/lint): per-rule mode overrides. A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

people_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the people lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-people.ts, route people/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

phase_gates.description: How strict each phase gate is (EE-156, packages/naive/src/engine/phase-gate.ts, route system/phase-gate): a preset from packages/naive/src/phases/gate-policies.json, per-item overrides, and whether lifecycle advance refuses a fail-closed shortfall. Without enforce the gate is reported only.

enforce.description: When true, each fail-closed shortfall blocks lifecycle advance unless a person overrides it with a reason

count_levels.description: The minimum count of consenting interviews that reaches each level, in place of count_levels in packages/naive/src/phases/gate-policies.json (5 for moderate, 10 for high). packages/naive/src/engine/gate-calibration.ts proposes them from the venture's market (EE-157)

staleness_months.description: Evidence collected more than this many months ago drops one level when the gate grades it; default 18. packages/naive/src/engine/gate-calibration.ts proposes 9 for a fast industry or an emerging market (EE-157)

items.description: Per phase, per gate item: the minimum evidence level and the boundary

routes.description: The routes the rule covers, in the router's own path patterns (X-6): a route (validation/pricing), an [id] segment (money/[id]), * for one segment and ** for any depth (validation/**, which covers validation too)

actors.description: Who it applies to; default agents only

roles.description: Team-plan roles it applies to; default every role

confidence_below.description: Applies when the write carries a confidence score below this number, or below the named threshold. The score is computed before the write; a write with no score never matches

exists.description: Applies only when the record already exists (true) or does not yet (false)

then.description: draft: hold it as a draft; owner: hold it as a draft sent to the function owner; refuse: do not write it

owner.description: The owner a routed write goes to; default the function owner in owners, else the record's decision-class owner, else founder

variants.description: Keep differing drafts side by side under one decision (X-2)
